recipes.name: Vanilla Chai Spiced Latte Mix
instructions: When you're ready to make a latte, add 1 Tbsp of the mix to a cup.
Then add 1 cup (240 mL) of hot barista oat milk or any plant-based milk of your choosing.
Top with whipped cream, foam, or a sprinkle of cinnamon, if desired. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Vanilla sugar is granulated sugar infused with vanilla beans, commonly used in European kitchens. It can easily be substituted with regular granulated sugar and a splash of vanilla extract.
Storage Store sealed in a well-sealed jar in a cool and dry place for up to 6 months.
